QuestInfo.name: Dial H For Hero 2
QuestInfo.1: Three Moon sent you to #bGold Beach#k. Look for survivors from your world, and see if you can help out the residents of Gold Beach while you're at it.
QuestInfo.2: You've recovered all the missing people from #bGold Beach#k. Go ask Three Moon if there are more people in other areas.
QuestInfo.0: You've rescued everyone who ended up in Ellinel. That means everyone else might be somewhere in Maple World, too! Go ask Three Moon if there have been any other disturbances like the one in Ellinel. \r\n
